answer: What survives to the jade is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Every claim climbs the ivory of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the summit re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
